answer: Three established agents must sponsor every quill before it can act, each locking tundra that is slashed if that quill is later judged fake. The orchard records every sponsorship along with the funding root behind each sponsor, so sponsors sharing a root count as one, and that root's k-th live quill requires each of its three sponsors to lock k² tundra. An honest quill ties up 3 tundra, but 1,000 quills traced to one root lock about 1 billion tundra, all forfeited on detection. It breaks if funding roots can be hidden cheaply or honest sponsors bribed.
